title: Positive Test: Successful LTE Initial Attach and Detach of Single UE under Excellent Radio Conditions
preconditions: Single isolated LTE cell with no inter-cell interference is active
One stationary UE (real or emulated) placed under excellent LTE RSRP as per Clause 4.6
All other cells are powered off
Test configuration parameters recorded
End-to-end LTE setup operational and stable
testSteps: Start call flow and signalling message logging
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure
Wait for successful attach indication (Attach Accept and Attach Complete messages)
Verify UE is attached to the correct LTE cell by checking PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN
Power OFF the UE to initiate LTE detach procedure
Wait for successful detach indication (Detach Accept and UE context release messages)
Stop and save the test logs
Repeat the above steps for a total of 10 iterations
expectedResults: Each attach and detach attempt completes successfully with 100% success rate
Attach latency measured and recorded for each iteration
UE remains attached to the correct cell throughout attach procedure
Signalling messages conform to 3GPP TS 23.401 clauses 5.3.2.1 and 5.3.8.2.1
commandsUsed: generic action: Monitor attach signaling messages
generic action: Monitor detach signaling messages
verificationMethods: Analyze captured logs for attach/detach success messages
Verify KPI records for success rate and latency
Check UE cell identity parameters in logs

title: Positive Test: Successful 5G NSA Initial Attach and Secondary Node Addition with Single UE under Excellent Radio Conditions
preconditions: Single isolated cell with LTE and 5G NSA cells active
One stationary UE (real or emulated) placed under excellent 5G SS-RSRP as per Clause 4.6
All other cells except the serving one are powered off
Test configuration parameters recorded
End-to-end 5G NSA setup operational and stable
testSteps: Start call flow and signalling message logging
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach procedure
Wait for successful LTE initial attach (Attach Accept and Complete messages)
Wait for successful Secondary Node Addition (SgNB Addition Request and Reconfiguration Complete messages)
Verify UE is attached to correct LTE and 5G cells by checking PCI, Global eNB ID, Global gNB ID, ARFCN, and NR-ARFCN
Power OFF the UE to initiate 5G NSA detach procedure
Wait for successful detach indication including Secondary Node Release
Stop and save the test logs
Repeat the above steps for a total of 10 iterations
expectedResults: 100% success rate for LTE attach, Secondary Node Addition, and detach procedures
Attach latency and secondary node addition latency measured and recorded
Signalling messages conform to 3GPP TS 23.401 Clause 5.3.2.1 and 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.2.1
Secondary Node Release procedure follows 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1
commandsUsed: generic action: Monitor LTE attach messages
generic action: Monitor SgNB addition messages
generic action: Monitor detach and SN release messages
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for attach, SgNB addition, and detach success messages
Verify KPI success rates and latencies
Check UE cell identities for LTE and 5G cells

title: Performance Test: Measure Attach and Detach Latency and Success Rate over 10 Iterations Under Excellent Radio Conditions
preconditions: Single isolated LTE or 5G NSA cell active
UE placed under excellent radio conditions as per Clause 4.6
Test configuration parameters recorded
End-to-end setup operational
testSteps: Start call flow and signalling message logging
Repeat 10 times:
Power ON UE to initiate attach
Wait for attach success and record latency (time from attach request to attach complete)
Power OFF UE to initiate detach
Wait for detach success
Stop and save the test logs
Calculate minimum, average, and maximum attach latency
Calculate attach and detach success rates
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates are 100%
Latency values fall within expected performance targets
No failures or anomalies during repeated attach-detach cycles
commandsUsed: generic action: Monitor attach signaling messages and measure latency
generic action: Monitor detach signaling messages
verificationMethods: Analyze logs to extract latency and success metrics
Verify KPI tables (Table 5-2 and Table 5-3) are populated correctly
Confirm stability and consistency of results

title: Integration Test: Verify Coordination of MN and SN During 5G NSA Secondary Node Release Procedure
preconditions: 5G NSA cell with MN and SN active
UE attached with active EN-DC
Test configuration parameters recorded
End-to-end setup operational
testSteps: Start call flow and signalling message logging
Trigger Secondary Node Release initiated by MN
Verify MN sends SgNB Release Request message and SN responds with SgNB Release Request Acknowledge
Verify RRCConnectionReconfiguration message includes SCG release instructions to UE
Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report to MN
Confirm SN releases UE context upon UE Context Release message from MN
Repeat with SN initiated Secondary Node Release and verify equivalent message flows
Stop and save the test logs
expectedResults: MN and SN properly coordinate SN release as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1
Data forwarding and reporting messages are properly exchanged
UE receives and applies SCG release configuration correctly
No signaling or resource release errors occur
commandsUsed: generic action: Trigger MN initiated SN release procedure
generic action: Monitor SgNB Release Request and Acknowledge messages
generic action: Monitor RRCConnectionReconfiguration messages to UE
generic action: Monitor SN Status Transfer and Data Usage Report messages
generic action: Trigger SN initiated SN release procedure
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling flows for message correctness and timing
Verify UE applies SCG release without errors
Check logs for data forwarding coordination
Confirm resource release at SN

title: Compatibility Test: Verify LTE and 5G NSA Attach-Detach Procedures Across Different UE Emulators and Real Devices
preconditions: Test environment supports multiple UE types (real devices and emulators)
Single isolated cell configured for LTE and 5G NSA
Test configuration recorded for each UE type
testSteps: For each UE type:
Place UE under excellent radio conditions
Perform 10 attach and detach cycles for LTE
Perform 10 attach and detach cycles for 5G NSA
Record success rates and latencies
Compare test results across UE types
expectedResults: All UE types successfully complete attach and detach procedures
No significant differences in KPI values beyond expected variation
Logs confirm protocol compliance for all UE types
Any compatibility issues are identified and documented
commandsUsed: generic action: Power ON and OFF various UE types
generic action: Start and stop logging for each UE
generic action: Monitor attach and detach signaling messages
generic action: Collect and compare KPI data
verificationMethods: Analyze KPI metrics across UE types
Review protocol message flows in logs
Document any inconsistencies or errors
